title: Impact of Postponement of World Economic Forum Meeting on Singapore's Preparations
what_it_is: Impact of Postponement of World Economic Forum Meeting on Singapore's Preparations

sections.label: WEF Singapore meeting rescheduled
sections.summary: The WEF moved its Special Annual Meeting in Singapore from 25 to 28 May 2021 to 17 to 20 August 2021, citing global travel restrictions and COVID-19 challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The WEF rescheduled the Special Annual Meeting in Singapore from 25 to 28 May 2021, to 17 to 20 August 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The WEF explained that the current restrictions on global travel and the challenges that many countries are facing in combating the COVID-19 virus, have made it challenging to plan for an in-person meeting in this half of the year.

sections.label: WEF meeting safe business events
sections.summary: The WEF Special Annual Meeting falls under STB's Safe Business Events Framework, covering testing and safe management measures, with about 29 such events held so far.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my Parliamentary Question response about two weeks ago, the WEF Special Annual Meeting is subject to the Singapore Tourism Board's (STB's) Safe Business Events Framework and that includes testing, safe management measures and so on and so forth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: This will apply to the WEF's Special Annual Meeting, but we are building our muscle to test, to trace, to vaccinate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We thus far had about 29 of these business events.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If you look at other kinds of events like the ONE Championship as well as the ATP Tour coming up this weekend.
